title: A continuous eosinophil–neutrophil interaction did not improve wheeze prediction across NHANES samples
abstract: A single log-count eosinophil-by-neutrophil interaction added to additive blood-count and standard spirometry models did not improve wheeze prediction from NHANES2007–08 (n=3520) to 2011–12 (n=3516, Brier difference 0.00005474) or additional 2009–10 confirmation (n=3944, difference 0.00001008). Negative incremental-prediction result, not biological equivalence or evidence against granulocyte phenotypes. Training-refit uncertainty spans benefit and harm. Prior outcome reuse limits the original target; additional confirmation was registered after that test.
